# Proposed owner diagnostic: v0.2.17 callback definition names

Await explicit approval of this exact build and protocol before installing or
running it. The implementation and offline reviewer are accepted; this v17
build is not game-tested. Latest preserved v16 run reported a natural Deathtrap
end, but the log recorded OTHER_NAME without the supplied identifier.
V17 makes the existing bounded Name read visible; it adds no SDK getter.

Exact title: **UVH v0.2.17 - CALLBACK DEFINITION NAMES**.
Original ZIP: UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost_v0.2.17_folder_install.zip.
44,658 bytes; SHA256 d46d8b3d91416920f9624161e90dfb06f685673b87afd0dbc9d70897da4a233d.
Runtime/package commit: db0a3f9e2ee267debdb164514d5b100dc5a78521 / draft PR37.
Strict reviewer commit: 07b242d74479dc3aa39f54f8c089d99ccdcc1913 / draft PR38.
The reviewer did not change or rebuild the package.

1. **GAME FULLY CLOSED — install after approval.** Use your already-backed-up
   solo Gaige. If that condition is not met, stop before beginning. Extract
   this exact ZIP into Borderlands 2's sdk_mods folder using the usual single
   project-folder replacement. Keep only one UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost
   folder, containing __init__.py, pyproject.toml and README.txt, rather than
   adding a second copy. Leave SDK/core mods and saves alone.
2. **MAIN MENU — verify Offline, Gaige and the mod title.** Launch Borderlands 2
   in Offline/solo mode with Gaige selected. Open this mod's options and verify
   the exact title above. **Do not select ARM item 1.** Close the options, select
   **Continue**, and wait until Gaige is fully loaded into your current map.
3. **FULLY LOADED MAP — start the reader once.** Open this mod's options and
   select **22 - START CALLBACK DEFINITION NAMES (NO ARM)** once. If it refuses,
   shows an error, or the option is missing, skip the summon and go to cleanup
   below. Do not retry START or switch to another trace.
4. **GAMEPLAY IN THE SAME MAP — summon once and watch the natural end.** Close
   the options and use your normal action-skill key to summon Deathtrap once.
   Stay in place without seeking combat or kills, and let Deathtrap end naturally.
   Allow **at most about 90 seconds from selecting START 22**, stopping sooner
   when Deathtrap ends or the reader stops/refuses/errors. If the action skill
   is unavailable or Deathtrap has not ended within that bound, stop and report
   it. Do not respec, buy, travel, boost, summon again or wait longer to chase data.
5. **IN THE MAP — stop and cancel.** Open this mod's options. Select
   **23 - STOP / REPORT CALLBACK DEFINITION NAMES**, then
   **3 - CANCEL / RESTORE NATIVE ARRAYS (THEN RESTART)**. Follow this cleanup path
   even after a refusal, timeout or no observation. No node was armed or inserted;
   CANCEL is cleanup and does not invoke the separate manual Duration restore.
   If cleanup controls are missing or the game cannot reach them, fully exit and
   report that result without retrying or relaunching.
6. **FULL EXIT — desktop, then wait for preservation.** Quit Borderlands 2 all
   the way to the desktop. Despite the option's THEN RESTART label, **do not
   relaunch yet**: the complete log and installed project files must be preserved
   first. Do not retry this test when no event appears.
7. **REPORT WHAT HAPPENED.** Confirm START 22, one summon and whether Deathtrap
   ended naturally (or why you stopped), STOP 23, CANCEL 3 and full desktop exit.
   Mention visible errors, missing controls or any deviation. A suggested reply:
   "START 22 once, Deathtrap summoned once and ended naturally, STOP 23,
   CANCEL 3 and full exit completed; [any error or deviation]."

This proposes one ordinary Deathtrap use only. No ARM, metadata item4, passive
items20/21, other trace, buying, respec, travel, manual boost, automatic effect,
co-op or save/private-backup operation. The agent performs no installation,
game control, native SDK action, engine invocation or flag/write experiment.

The reader records callback-local primitive assertions at attempted PRE entry.
A Name or wrapper match establishes no manager ownership, unique active summon,
native generation, successful deactivation, clock, lifespan or Duration effect.
Silence, refusal, timeout or failure is a valid result and is preserved without
retry. The agent will record your report separately from log/process/provenance
checks, without claiming to have observed your UI, keypresses, wait or natural end.

After your full-exit report, the claimed capture task can preserve the stable
complete game log, manifest and three installed project snapshots exclusively.
Public export of those five files will require its own exact-content approval
after review. This proposed gameplay approval does not publish a future log,
approve another run, spend points, change saves, merge or release anything.
